instruction:
Write a security-hardened Dockerfile for a Node.js app.
- Run as a non-root user
- Use COPY instead of ADD
- No secrets in the image
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY --chown=node:node . .
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

instruction:
Write a security-hardened Dockerfile for a Python app.
- Run as non-root
- Use .dockerignore conceptually (mention it)
- No pip cache
- Port 8000
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN useradd -m -r appuser
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that uses a distroless base image for maximum security.
- Go app compiled statically
- No shell in final image
- Port 8080
output:
FROM golang:1.22 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o server .

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot
COPY --from=builder /app/server /server
EXPOSE 8080
USER nonroot:nonroot
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Go app that drops all Linux capabilities.
- Final stage uses setcap to drop
- Port 8080
output:
FROM golang:1.22 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o server .

FROM alpine:3.19
RUN apk add --no-cache libcap \
    && setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' /usr/local/bin/server 2>/dev/null || true
COPY --from=builder /app/server /usr/local/bin/server
EXPOSE 8080
USER nobody
ENTRYPOINT ["server"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that verifies checksums of downloaded artifacts.
- Verify a tarball checksum before extracting
- Port 8080
output:
FROM alpine:3.19
ARG VERSION=1.0.0
ARG CHECKSUM=abc123def456
RUN wget https://example.com/app-${VERSION}.tar.gz \
    && echo "${CHECKSUM}  app-${VERSION}.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c - \
    && tar -xzf app-${VERSION}.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin \
    && rm app-${VERSION}.tar.gz
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["app"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Python app that uses a virtual environment.
- venv isolates dependencies
- Run as non-root
- Port 8000
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN useradd -m -r appuser
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that implements a health check without curl/wget.
- Use the app binary itself for healthcheck
- Port 8080
output:
FROM golang:1.22 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o server .

FROM alpine:3.19
COPY --from=builder /app/server /usr/local/bin/server
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD ["/usr/local/bin/server", "-healthcheck"]
CMD ["server"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that uses multi-stage to exclude build tools from final image.
- Builder has compilers
- Final is slim runtime only
- Port 8080
output:
FROM golang:1.22 AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -o server .

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN useradd -m -r appuser
COPY --from=builder /app/server /usr/local/bin/server
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["server"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js app that uses npm audit in the build.
- Fail build on high vulnerabilities
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
RUN npm audit --audit-level=high
COPY . .
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that uses a custom entrypoint script for security setup.
- Entrypoint drops privileges
- Port 8080
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that uses BuildKit secret mounts for secrets.
- Use --mount=type=secret
- Port 8080
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=api_key cat /run/secrets/api_key > /app/api_key.txt
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that removes unnecessary packages after build.
- Clean apt cache
- Remove docs/man
- Port 8080
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    gcc \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/requirements.txt \
    && apt-get purge -y gcc \
    && apt-get autoremove -y \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /tmp/* /var/tmp/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that uses a minimal base like Alpine for a Java app.
- Use eclipse-temurin alpine variant
- Port 8080
output:
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine
RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app
WORKDIR /app
COPY target/app.jar app.jar
USER app
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that implements signed image verification.
- Verify GPG signature of a downloaded artifact
- Port 8080
output:
FROM alpine:3.19
RUN apk add --no-cache gnupg
ARG VERSION=1.0.0
RUN wget https://example.com/app-${VERSION}.tar.gz \
    && wget https://example.com/app-${VERSION}.tar.gz.sig \
    && wget https://example.com/key.asc \
    && gpg --import key.asc \
    && gpg --verify app-${VERSION}.tar.gz.sig app-${VERSION}.tar.gz \
    && tar -xzf app-${VERSION}.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin \
    && rm app-${VERSION}.tar.gz app-${VERSION}.tar.gz.sig key.asc
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["app"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile that uses a non-executable stack and other hardening flags for a C app.
- Compile with security flags
- Port 8080
output:
FROM gcc:13 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN gcc -o server -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -Wformat -Wformat-security -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now main.c

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN useradd -m -r appuser
COPY --from=builder /app/server /usr/local/bin/server
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["server"]
